title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — Fix godman-tag-all.sh tag format mismatch (pact-v0.2.0)
description: Bug: godman-tag-all.sh creates tags as 'godman-protocols/pact@v0.2.0' but cmdGodman() and cmdGodmanPreflight() check for 'pact-v0.2.0'. This means /godman-tag confirm never fixes the 0/8 tagged status shown in /godman and /godman-preflight. Fix: change TAG variable in godman-tag-all.sh to use format '${proto}-v${VERSION}' to match both check sites.

tasks.title: Fix scripts/godman-tag-all.sh: change TAG format from 'godman-protocols/pact@v0.2.0' to 'pact-v0.2.0'
